svg.title: Om Solanki on shuffle
svg.desc: A headphone-wearing duck sits on a cassette deck above the Bengaluru skyline at night. Six tracks cover search, computer vision, language models, arcade games, full-stack apps and data experiments.

g.text: Follow a chat answer back to its report.
Look at the pixels behind a prediction.
Give two models the same seven numbers.
Keep score while fifty teams play.
Give tonight’s kitchen shift to a flatmate.
Turn up the delay and watch frames drop.
